payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates over candidate leader counts l from 2 to n//2, counting those where n % l == 0.
payload.rationale: The code performs a simple linear scan over all possible l values, which is a complete search but does not use backtracking. Among the provided subtypes, search_backtracking is the only one capturing exhaustive enumeration, so it is the closest match despite the mismatch in technique.
